outcome: Prevalence of LUTS during pregnancy and at 1 and 7 years postpartum
cohort: 3862 women who responded at 1 year and 1115 women who responded at 7 years out of 10,098 primipara recruited during the third trimester
finding: Cesarean section was associated with a decreased prevalence of both storage and voiding LUTS 7 years after delivery compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a lower prevalence of LUTS compared to vaginal delivery.
